subject: otter
name: 小水獭
label: 抱贝壳的小水獭
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. Pure white background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One baby otter seated front view holding one large shell, round head, small ears and broad tapered tail. Smooth open contours and empty interiors: absolutely no fur strokes, hair, feather texture, scales or hatching. Keep 10 percent clear space on every side.
